title: String Theory Alternative: Pure Geometric Photon Circulation and Thermodynamic Inversion in a Dual-Universe Framework
summary: We present a comprehensive, four-dimensional alternative to string theory that resolves the black hole information paradox without invoking extra dimensions, dark energy, or fine-tuned cosmological constants. By formalizing a symmetric Dual-Universe geometry, we demonstrate that photon conservation is maintained through a closed-loop recycling mechanism across inverted manifolds. We analyze the explicit inversions of thermodynamics (the entropy reset button), density profiles (hot/dense vs. cold/hollow), and structural information symmetry.
